patch_resolves_note: The authoritative fixed build still reaches the group-name terminator write, but its repaired clamp keeps `name_len` at 255 before `namebuf[name_len] = 0`, so the protected event executes with an in-bounds subscript.

root_cause_criterion.obligation: In the `OWNER_GROUP_NAME` branch, the clamped `name_len` must stay strictly less than `sizeof(namebuf)` before `namebuf[name_len] = 0` executes.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable clamp leaves `name_len == OWNER_MAXNAMELEN` when the parsed group-name length reaches 256, so the later terminator write indexes `char namebuf[256]` at 256. The fixed program changes this branch to clamp the stored length to `OWNER_MAXNAMELEN - 1`, preserving the same write while keeping the subscript in bounds.

nodes.state: At the sanitizer sink, the terminating store uses a `name_len` subscript that is greater than or equal to `sizeof(namebuf)`, so the NUL write lands outside `char namebuf[256]`.

edges.relation: The same clamped `name_len` computed in the group-name branch is reused unchanged as the subscript in the later `namebuf[name_len] = 0` sink.
